content.title: Here Are the 15 Best National Pi Day Deals for 2026
content.text: Key PointsPi Day is Saturday, March 14, 2026.To celebrate, many pizza chains are offering $3.14 pizza deals nationwide.Here are a list of the 15 best National Pi Day deals for 2026. Although it isn’t an official day on the calendar, Pi Day is one of the most anticipated holidays of the year. Sure, it might not come with copious amounts of presents or some mystical lore personified by a titular character like the Easter Bunny or Cupid, but when the veritable mascot is pizza, what more can you ask for? If we’re being honest, Pi Day might just be a perfect holiday. There’s no pretense or expectations, no running around to grab last-minute gifts—just several slices of your favorite pie and vibes. But if you can enjoy pizza any day of the year, what makes Pi Day so special? Watch More Beyond the fact that March 14 works out to 3.14, the mathematical equivalent of pi (π), pizza restaurants big and small celebrate the perfectly synchronized day by offering mouthwatering deals, including several $3.14 pies. Can you name a tastier equation? Luckily, if you’re looking to partake in the festivities but have no clue where to start, we’ve rounded up the 15 best National Pi Day deals of 2026 all in one spot for you. 😋😋 SIGN UP to get delicious recipes, handy kitchen hacks & more in our daily Pop Kitchen newsletter 🍳🍔 1. &pizza Although it’s still a relative newcomer on the pizza scene &pizza has been doing Pi Day big for years. And this year, the brand is giving fans so much more than just a $3.14 pie—not that we’re complaining. In addition to offering guests a $3.14 pizza with the purchase of another pie using promo code “PIDAY,” the brand is also bringing back its coveted &pass, which gives fans in the know access to a special, heavily discounted pizza offer for a set number of pies. The ultra-exclusive pass will only be available on Pi Day, and fans who want in will need to download the &pizza app and enable push notifications or join “The Pizza Plug” SMS program by texting JOIN to 64671. As if that wasn’t already plenty, &pizza is also celebrating love on Pi Day and giving four lucky couples the chance to say “Pi Do,” completely free of charge. The following participating couples will exchange vows officiated by &pizza’s chief marketing officer and “unifier of love,” Sergio Pérez, who is ordained to preside over each ceremony: Chelsea & Jay have kept a five-year tradition of celebrating every Friday the 13th with pizza night. Newly engaged, they say, “an &pizza wedding is perfectly on-brand” for their relationship. Marissa & Lawrence have been &pizza fans since their early date nights in 2016. Marissa once jokingly applied to marry &pizza itself—and even got an &pizza tattoo while Lawrence held her hand. Nearly a decade later, they’re finally making it official. Sam & Danielle moved to Washington, D.C., in 2018 and quickly made their neighborhood &pizza a go-to spot for late nights, lazy mornings, and everything in between. Even as New Yorkers with strong pizza opinions, they found a pie they could both love. Crystal & Eric bond over their shared love of pizza—even while living in different states. Because Crystal is a nurse and Eric serves in the Army, their schedules and locations often keep them apart. Whether they’re together on weekends or FaceTiming during long weeks apart, pizza has always been their favorite way to connect. This year’s ceremonies will take place at the &pizza location at 666 Monroe St. NE in Washington, D.C., and the reception will be held at the Hive Rooftop at Hotel Hive, located at 2224 F St. NW. One plus one equals pi forever. Now that’s some tasty math we can get behind. 2. 7-Eleven Courtesy of 7-Eleven Although it isn’t exactly a pizza restaurant proper, 7-Eleven isn’t skipping out on delivering some tasty math this Pi Day, and they’ve got something for everyone. Starting March 13 through March 14, participating 7-Eleven, Speedway, and Stripes stores will offer: $3.14 Whole Pizza: 7Rewards and Speedy Rewards members can enjoy any whole Pizza for just $3.14 in stores and via the 7NOW Delivery app. Speedy Café is also offering a large one-topping pizza for the same price. $3.14 Quesadillas: Laredo Taco Company locations are bringing the sizzle with golden, crispy, cheese-stuffed quesadillas for only $3.14. 31.4-Cent Cinnamon Sugar Fried Pies: Raise the Roost restaurants are adding a sweet treat to the lineup with Cinnamon Sugar Fried Pies for just 31.4 cents. $1, 7-Select Snack Pies: $1, 7-Select Snack Pies complete the equation with the perfect fruity delight. 3. Anthony’s Coal Fired Pizza & Wings Newsweek’s Best Pizza Chain of 2025 isn’t missing out on all the tasty Pi Day fun (or cheesy math puns) and is offering diners a 10-inch coal-fired cheese pizza for $3.14 with any beverage purchase. The only catch is you’ll have to dine in to take advantage of the deal, and it’ll only be available through 4 p.m. on March 14. 4. Blaze Pizza Did you know that Blaze Pizza offers over 45 premium ingredients that you can choose from to build your own perfect pie? That roughly works out to a staggering 35,184,372,088,832 possible combinations, meaning you could probably go for years without having the same pizza twice. Now that’s some tasty math. Here’s an even tastier equation for you: Blaze Pizza is celebrating Pi Day by offering a deal made to share. The build-your-own-pizza brand is offering fans who purchase one 11-inch pizza to get a second 11-inch pizza of equal or lesser value for just $3.14 at participating Blaze Pizza locations nationwide. To add even more value to the equation, Blaze is also giving guests who visit on March 14 a digital code for a buy-one-get-one-free 11-inch pizza to use on their next visit. Simply place your order for delivery or pickup through the Blaze App and apply the provided code at checkout. What could be more delicious than that? 5. Crust Pizza Co. If you’re in the mood for Chicago’s real pizza, the elusive tavern-style, and are lucky enough to live near one of Crust Pizza Co.’s 41 locations, then you might want to make a beeline this Pi Day and grab a slice. The growing pizza chain, concentrated primarily in Texas (for now), is offering diners a large one-topping pizza for $3.14 with the purchase of any large pizza on its menu. Just make sure to save us a slice. 6. Marco’s Pizza Despite how objective people’s pizza preferences can be, we’d venture so far as to say that no one will complain if the option is Marco’s. Beyond just making a great pie, Marco’s has some of the most flavorful combinations you’ll find at a chain, and you can tell each pie is made with love. And of course, they’re getting in on the Pi Day action by offering guests who buy any large or extra-large pizza a medium one-topping pizza for $3.14 with the code PIDAY. 7. MOD Pizza If you’re someone who can’t agree on pizza toppings or you’re just a more-is-more kind of person, then MOD Pizza is the place for you. MOD believes that all pizzas are welcome, no matter how wacky and outrageous they might be. You want anchovies, roasted garlic, and gorgonzola on your pie? Have it! Craving something simple like a marghareta pizza? The world is your oyster. Beyond just being a judgment-free pizza zone, though, MOD is also gearing up for Pi Day by offering 314 lucky people who order MOD Pizza online using code IRRATIONAL during checkout a MOD-size Pizza for just $3.14. And if you aren’t one of the chosen 314 MOD is giving rewards to members $3.14 off their purchase of a MOD-size pizza all Pi Day long! The chain is also giving away a sick downloadable Pi Day poster you can grab here, no purchase required. 8. Mountain Mike’s Pizza The family-style pizza chain is gearing up for Pi Day by offering a reward to members who buy a medium pizza: another one-topping medium pizza for just $3.14. That means you can feed the whole brood without having to fight over who gets the last slice. 9. Newk’s Eatery Although Newk’s Eatery is known more for its freshly prepared sandwiches, soups, and salads, the homestyle fast-casual brand knows a thing or two about making killer pizza. To prove it, Newk’s is offering diners any classic pizza for just $3.14 with the purchase of an adult entree from March 13 through March 14 in honor of Pi Day. The offer is good for dine-in or carryout. Use code PIDAY26 at checkout. 10. Paisano’s Pizza Chef Paisano knows his way around a pie, and although there’s never a bad day to take a trip to the family-owned chain with 40 locations across the Mid-Atlantic, why not check out what Chef Paisano is whipping up on Pi Day? To commemorate the day, diners can grab a large cheese pizza for $3.14 with orders over $20 using the code PIDAY at checkout. 11. Papa John’s As if it wasn’t already enough to deliver our new favorite Michelin-quality pan pizza, Papa John’s is also delivering the deals this Pi Day by offering Papa Rewards members a second large or XL pizza for just $3.14 when they purchase the first. How’s that for a tasty equation? The chain is also rumored to be dropping exclusive deals all week long, March 14–20. 12. Pizza Hut Courtesy of Pizza Hut Despite recently closing some of its locations, Pizza Hut has been on a generational run, making an effort to revitalize the brand and capture the attention of younger, more discerning customers. From buzzy partnerships to limited-time deals, Pizza Hut is out to prove one thing: No one out-pizzas the Hut. It makes sense, then, that the brand would celebrate Pi Day in a way only Pizza Hut can: by offering one lucky fan the chance to be a Hut Crust Connoisseur and get paid to eat free pizza. Simply record a video of yourself reviewing Pizza Hut’s new hand-tossed pizza, upload it to Instagram with the hashtag #PizzaHut_Contest, and then fill out the application at pizzahutcrust.com. When it comes to perks of the job, not only will you get paid $31,415.92—aka pi—but you’ll also get to eat free pizza for an entire year. The math is definitely mathing. Additionally, Pizza Hut is offering a large three-topping pizza featuring its new hand-tossed crust for only $10 for a limited time. And if that still isn’t enough, you can feed a crowd with the new Pizza Charcuterie Board. 13. Round Table Pizza The royal pizza palace, whose mission is to provide a perfect gathering place to enjoy everyone’s favorite dinner time staple, is getting in on the Pi Day fun by offering its Royal Rewards Members a one-topping personal pizza for $3.14 with the purchase of a Large or XL Pizza. You can join the royal roundtable for free on the chain’s app or online. 14. Sheetz Sheetz might be a convenience store, but they’re delivering the deals this Pi Day by celebrating for an entire week. From March 14–20, Sheetz customers can claim cheese or pepperoni pizza flatz for only $3.14 through the Sheetz app. 15. The Pizza Press Extra! Extra! Read all about it! The Pizza Press, known for crafting pies inspired by newspapers, is giving fans a newsworthy deal this Pi Day. Diners can order a 12-inch specialty pizza for just $3.14 on Saturday, March 14. Now that’s something worth talking about. About the authorKenn C. Bivins is a news writer for Parade and one of the site's resident puzzle experts, delivering daily guides for NYT games. He is an experienced Atlanta-based food and beverage writer, recipe developer and content creator.
